copy.tagline: 生成财务报告，包含KPI、损益表和展望
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要定期制作公司财务报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate financial reports with KPIs, P&L, and outlook
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create regular financial reports for your company

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按这个模板生成一页季度财报:顶部公司名与季度标题、4 个核心 KPI、收入图和烧钱图、P&L 概要表、5 条重点、展望段落,以及底部可折叠的方法说明区。
howto.when: 当你需要财务向单页报告,提到财报、P&L、MRR 等关键词时触发。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude generates a one-page quarterly finance report: masthead, 4 hero KPIs, revenue and burn charts, a P&L summary table, 5 highlights, an outlook paragraph, and a collapsible methodology section.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a one-page finance report and mention terms like financials, P&L, or MRR.
